name: What preventative measures can I take to extend the life of my exterior stairs after repair?

mainEntity.name: What preventative measures can I take to extend the life of my exterior stairs after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After exterior stair repair, you can extend their life by implementing several preventative measures. For wooden stairs, regularly cleaning off debris, applying protective stains or sealants, and ensuring proper drainage away from the stair base are crucial. For concrete stairs, prompt sealing of cracks and applying a quality concrete sealer can prevent water penetration and freeze-thaw damage. Regular inspections can help identify minor issues before they become major problems. Maintaining these preventative steps is a key part of maximizing the longevity of your repaired stairs and protecting your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Extend stair life after repair by cleaning, applying protective sealants (wood/concrete), ensuring drainage, and conducting regular inspections.
